We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer for a project delivered for a US client in the ConTech / FinTech space. This is a role for people who enjoy demanding technical challenges and take satisfaction from solving complex analytical and mathematical problems.

Location: remote work
Start: ASAP
Duration: until 31.01.2027 (approx. 6 months) with possible extension

About the project

The project concerns a system responsible for precise spatial calculations and automatic cost calculation of multi-million construction investments.

This is not a typical CRUD-based business application. Algorithms, business logic and mathematics play the key role here; Node.js and React are only the tools used to implement them.

Scope of work:
approx. 80% Backend (Node.js / TypeScript)
approx. 20% Frontend (React)

analysis and development of complex business logic
reverse engineering of existing solutions and analysis of system dependencies
design and optimisation of computational algorithms
work with 2D/3D computational geometry, coordinate systems and spatial data transformations
backend development and application performance optimisation

Node.js, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, AWS (Amazon Aurora), Docker, CI/CD

minimum 7 years of commercial experience as a Software Engineer, with particular emphasis on backend and system logic
very good knowledge of Node.js and TypeScript
practical knowledge of React
experience working with distributed architecture (Microservices, Event-driven, REST API)
experience in designing and optimising PostgreSQL queries at scale and knowledge of AWS (Amazon Aurora)
practical knowledge of Docker and CI/CD processes
care for code quality through unit tests, integration tests and code review
English at minimum B2+/C1 level

Someone with very strong analytical abilities, comfortable working with demanding business logic and complex algorithms.

A big advantage will be experience in:
modelling multidimensional data structures,
2D/3D computational geometry,
coordinate systems and spatial transformations,
vector mathematics,
designing algorithms solving complex computational problems.

Additional information

Availability required for syncs with the US team several times a week between 17:00-18:00 CET.

TECH STACK
English C1 | Node Advanced | React Advanced | AWS Advanced | geometry Advanced

Posted: 31.07.2026 | Full-Time | Remote | Salary not stated
Eligible regions listed on the posting: Czechia, Germany, Spain, Greece, Croatia, Kenya, North Macedonia, Nigeria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Serbia, South Africa

JOB DESCRIPTION

Michael and Daniel met in 2015 while working for a DAM company. They quickly realized that they share the same mindset on software development, keeping a close eye on the disruptive JavaScript technologies that came to life. A couple of weeks later, the idea of a GraphQL CMS came to their minds, so they built it.

As the first GraphQL native Headless CMS, our mission is to remove traditional content management pain points by using the power of GraphQL and take the idea of a Headless CMS to the next level. Today we have evolved as a federated content platform.

Our goal is to enable developers and content operators to create, enrich, unify, and deliver content across platforms seamlessly. We are trusted to manage content for teams from over 50,000 organizations like Dr. Oetker, Shure, Samsung, Ashley Furniture, Telenor, Philips, and Gamescom. With over $35M in funding led by One Peak, alongside OpenOcean, Peak, and SquareOne Venture Capital, you will be part of a remote-first and globally distributed team of about 70 team members, committed to working collaboratively, transparently, and passionately.

With our headquarters in Berlin, Germany, the rest of our team joins in from various parts of the world.

How will you make an impact?

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You'll ship features that solve real customer problems, contribute to our CMS core, extend our platform capabilities, and help bring AI-powered features to life. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. You'll use your judgment, collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and customers, and move fast using modern AI-assisted development tools.

This role is for someone who sees engineering as a team sport, takes ownership without waiting for permission, and thrives in an environment where initiative matters more than instructions.

What you will be working on:

Core CMS development: Evolve the GraphQL-native CMS powering enterprise teams worldwide, improving performance, reliability, and developer experience.
CMS extensions and integrations: Develop and maintain extensions that expand what customers can do with Hygraph.
AI-powered features: Contribute to our AI roadmap by building intelligent capabilities into the product.
Customer-facing improvements: Use monitoring data, customer feedback, and your product instinct to identify and fix problems before they're reported proactively.

Some of your tasks and responsibilities:

Collaborate in a cross-functional, autonomous team to deliver features and continuous improvements, often working from rough prototypes or early concepts rather than polished designs.
Translate business needs into technical solutions by working closely with the Product team. Occasionally, participate in customer conversations to validate that what you're building actually solves their problems.
Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, or similar) to accelerate development.
Proactively identify issues through monitoring and observability data. Then fix them, don't just flag them.
Contribute to architectural decisions that keep our platform scalable, reliable, and maintainable.
Share what you know, learn from others, and help your teammates grow. Engineering here is collaborative. We win together.

Job requirements

What we expect from you:

Significant experience (typically 6+ years) building and owning production systems, with strong full-stack skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and deep backend expertise, scalability, and performance fundamentals (ideally Node.js).
Experience building user interfaces, ideally with React.
Experience developing well-tested APIs with GraphQL.
Solid knowledge of relational databases (especially PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization.
Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in your workflow.
Familiarity with cloud-native development (AWS, GCP).
Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (New Relic, Datadog, or similar).
Openness and experience with on-call and operational work (investigations, incident response, etc.).
Ability to work with ambiguity: rough prototypes, evolving requirements, and imperfect information. You use judgment and experience to fill the gaps.
Strong product sense. You think about why you're building something, not just how. You care about the customer experience, not just the code.

Bonus points

Experience with Golang.
Knowledge of infrastructure as code tooling (Pulumi, Terraform).
Experience working directly with customers or in customer-facing roles.
Familiarity with headless CMS platforms or content infrastructure.

The Process

Intro call with People Team
Interview with the Hiring Manager
Technical Interview
C-Level Call and Reference Check (optional)
Job Offer

The response time after application, screening applications, and setting up the first intro call is usually within 1-2 weeks.

Experience with asynchronous, event-driven, or workflow-based distributed systems.
